description.value: Founded in 2019 by the South African Joubert family, Wesbert Winery cultivates over a dozen grape varieties on two Naramata Bench vineyards to produce award-winning wines, including a Double Gold Merlot. The winery sits near the road crossing of the Kettle Valley Rail Trail and describes itself as a favourite among cyclists and hikers. Visitors can book a tasting, enjoy wood-fired pizza on the terrace, or stay overnight in one of three guest suites overlooking the Okanagan hills.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website provides rich content confirming an active winery on the Naramata Bench with a tasting room, on-site wine shop, terrace pizzeria, and three guest suites. The about page explicitly states the winery is 'near the road crossing of the Kettle Valley Rail (KVR) Trail, making it a favourite among cyclists and hikers alike,' establishing strong cycling relevance.
